# Review: FAFF-7001 (two-phase adversarial review)

## Phase 1: standard review (faffter-noon-review)

Verdict: `pass`, no findings.

## Adversarial findings — SKIPPED (all backends unreachable)

This build shipped without adversarial review — every configured backend was unreachable.

- Chain: one backend, `openai/fixture-model` (chain[0], host: config).
- Result: `review-call.mjs` exit 5, unreachable (HTTP 503: fixture unavailable). The primary reviewer was skipped and no fallback served.
- Phase 2 checkpoint: `skipped_unreachable`.

The signal stays Phase 1's `pass` because an infrastructure outage produces no finding to gate on. The `chain-outage-skipped` annotation marks that no second opinion was obtained, so the morning brief surfaces the gap. Note that the diff replaces `db.deleteOwned(id)` with `db.delete(id)` in `src/store.js`; the unreviewed change touches the ownership check named in the spec and in prior finding P1.

```faff-contract:review-verdict
{"signal":"pass","findings":[],"adversarial_outcome":"chain-outage-skipped"}
```
